claim: When you create CloudFront signed URLs or signed cookies, you can specify an ending date and time after which the URL is no longer valid and, optionally, the date and time that the URL becomes valid and the IP address or range of addresses of the computers that can access your content.

evidence.quote: An ending date and time, after which the URL is no longer valid.
(Optional) The date and time that the URL becomes valid.
(Optional) The IP address or range of addresses of the computers that can be used to access your content.
